compiler.validation: sequence_extra_helpers_agree_per_backend: 16 cases on five executable backends

evidence.summary: Sixteen sequence helper and builder cases agree across the five executable backends, including exact runtime-length compaction results.
The repair uses exact bounded storage, carried state, and checked functional push; it does not add indexed mutation or general view-to-exact scatter.

reproduction.instructions: Run cargo test -p mncs-cli --test abi_boundary sequence_extra_helpers_agree_per_backend and compare the bounded builder with the legacy frame_generic scatter reproducer.

summary: Profile 0.18 now materializes runtime-length bounded byte-view selections through capacity-checked functional builders used by RAVEL, mncs-test, and mncs-actions. The original unrestricted scatter-write and view-to-exact requirement remains absent.

workaround.description: RAVEL, mncs-test, and mncs-actions use bounded builders; arbitrary frame widths and unrestricted scatter remain monomorphized or host-side.
